load_onnx_graph_from_file: load an ONNX model file and parse it into a TensorBoard GraphDef
parse_onnx_graph_to_graphdef: parse an ONNX graph into a TensorBoard GraphDef with NodeDef entries
convert_onnx_nodes_to_tensorboard_format: convert ONNX graph inputs, outputs, and nodes into TensorBoard NodeDef protobuf objects
extract_onnx_dtype_and_shape: extract tensor dtype and shape from ONNX graph inputs and build TensorShapeProto objects
map_onnx_node_names_with_op_prefix: build a name mapping from ONNX node names to op-prefixed identifiers for TensorBoard compatibility
